nodes.name: form.js
nodes.summary: Central Form class that orchestrates the entire form view lifecycle: rendering, layout, refresh, save/submit/cancel, workflow actions, sidebar, dashboard, toolbar, keyboard shortcuts, and event handlers.

nodes.name: form_tour.js
nodes.summary: Implements guided product tour overlay for forms, stepping through fields with tooltips and instructions.

nodes.name: form_viewers.js
nodes.summary: Displays avatars of users currently viewing the same document in real-time via socket.io.

nodes.name: formatters.js
nodes.summary: Field value formatters for display in forms, lists, and reports (currency, date, link, duration, percent, etc.).

nodes.name: grid.js
nodes.summary: Implements the editable data grid for Table child-table fields: row CRUD, pagination, bulk actions, sorting, column resize, import/export.

nodes.name: grid_pagination.js
nodes.summary: Pagination controls for grid rows, handling page size, navigation, and visible-row filtering.

nodes.name: grid_row.js
nodes.summary: Represents a single editable row in a table grid with inline controls, expand-to-form, move/copy/delete, and field rendering.

nodes.name: grid_row_form.js
nodes.summary: Expanded row detail form view shown when a grid row is opened for full editing.

nodes.name: info_card.js
nodes.summary: Renders informational cards for form sidebar with title, indicator, and content areas.

nodes.name: layout.js
nodes.summary: Form field layout composer: builds sections, columns, tabs from DocType metadata and manages field rendering and visibility.
